source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The human bustage port removes the deleted Gecko release_flatpak_repackage transform import from the kind chain. Other transforms remain. At the fixed revision the kind names a comm transform instead; the original import removal does not mean Flatpak functionality was abandoned. Upstream transform internals and actual decision-task generation remain outside this patch audit. No release or taskgraph execution ran.
title: A removed upstream transform can break taskgraph loading before any release task runs
